task_summary: Implement a public permutation API in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py, following the stated behavior and constraints.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Return all distinct permutations of input characters in sorted lexicographic order; the empty string has one permutation, the empty string.
Inputs contain at most seven characters.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least two passing unittest methods exercising the public API and cover ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs, or invalid numeric inputs if no collection is accepted.
Retain all stated behavior and compatibility requirements.

success_criteria.description: The unittest suite passes using the requested discovery command.
The public API returns distinct permutations in sorted lexicographic order, handles empty input as one empty permutation, and the tests cover these behaviors with at least two unittest methods.
